# tessera tessera.full_graph.i8i8.v1 scalar reference (integer datapath, bit-exact against the HDL)
# graph: graph
# arena: 1404 words x 16 bits (2124 words without lifetime reuse), 1 multiplier(s), acc_width 20 (|acc| <= 438932), product_width 39
# frame beats 9770 = load 108 + steps 8798 + drain 864 (plan estimate 10785)
# total_macs 7488
# steps:
#   0 stem lanes=1 macs=3888 read_beats=3888 mac_beats=3888 epilogue_beats=144 store_beats=144 pipeline_beats=2 generated_cycles=3890 plan_estimated_cycles=4639
#   1 dw lanes=1 macs=1296 read_beats=1296 mac_beats=1296 epilogue_beats=144 store_beats=144 pipeline_beats=2 generated_cycles=1298 plan_estimated_cycles=1589
#   2 mid lanes=1 macs=576 read_beats=576 mac_beats=576 epilogue_beats=144 store_beats=144 pipeline_beats=2 generated_cycles=578 plan_estimated_cycles=742
#   3 add.3 lanes=0 macs=0 read_beats=288 mac_beats=0 epilogue_beats=0 store_beats=144 pipeline_beats=2 generated_cycles=290 plan_estimated_cycles=403
#   4 upsample_nearest2x.3 lanes=0 macs=0 read_beats=576 mac_beats=0 epilogue_beats=0 store_beats=576 pipeline_beats=2 generated_cycles=578 plan_estimated_cycles=742
#   5 head lanes=1 macs=1728 read_beats=1728 mac_beats=1728 epilogue_beats=432 store_beats=432 pipeline_beats=2 generated_cycles=1730 plan_estimated_cycles=2097
#   6 quantize_u8_output lanes=0 macs=0 read_beats=432 mac_beats=0 epilogue_beats=0 store_beats=432 pipeline_beats=2 generated_cycles=434 plan_estimated_cycles=573
# slots:
#   p0.v0 offset=0 shape=3x6x6 domain=i8 max_abs=127
#   p1.v0 offset=108 shape=4x6x6 domain=i8 max_abs=127
#   p2.v0 offset=252 shape=4x6x6 domain=i8 max_abs=127
#   p3.v0 offset=396 shape=4x6x6 domain=i8 max_abs=127
#   p3.v1 offset=252 shape=4x6x6 domain=i9 max_abs=254
#   p3.v2 offset=396 shape=4x12x12 domain=i9 max_abs=254
#   image.v0 offset=972 shape=3x12x12 domain=u8 max_abs=255
#   output.u8 offset=0 shape=3x12x12 domain=u8 max_abs=255
# manifest f32 vs emitted fixed point (NOT a bit-exact claim):
#   step 2 mid: 1/144 codes differ, max |difference| 1
#   step 3 add.3: 1/144 codes differ, max |difference| 1
#   step 4 upsample_nearest2x.3: 4/576 codes differ, max |difference| 1
#   step 5 head: 4/432 codes differ, max |difference| 12
#   step 6 quantize_u8_output: 4/432 codes differ, max |difference| 12
# note: graph lowering notes: layer stem: `relu` graph op skipped; the fused activation is carried by the convolution op's activation field; layer dw: int32 bias is all zero and was dropped (exact identity); layer dw: `relu` graph op skipped; the fused activation is carried by the convolution op's activation field; layer mid: int32 bias is all zero and was dropped (exact identity); layer mid: `relu` graph op skipped; the fused activation is carried by the convolution op's activation field; add on point 3: branch requant factor 0.014/0.03 serialized to M0=122334 shift=18 (worst relative error 1.022e-6); layer head: int32 bias is all zero and was dropped (exact identity)
# note: activation arena words are 16-bit because the residual `add` is unclamped (intref.rs:257-268), so codes leave the i8 domain after a residual sum
# note: one shared single-lane engine: exactly one 16x8 MAC multiplier and one 20x17 requantization multiplier serve every step of the schedule (DSP count does not grow with the layer count); steps differ only in the muxed address/control they present
# note: arena allocation reuses words by tensor lifetime: 1404 words peak against 2124 words if every slot were kept live; the plan's activation-RAM region covers it
# note: requantization is the fixed-point `(acc*M0 + round) >> shift` datapath; the manifest's f32 coefficients are reported separately and are NOT reproduced bit for bit (bounded by Requant::multiplier_error_ppm)
# note: timed structure: every read is registered (one cycle); the MAC stage consumes the previous address stage, so a product lands every cycle and a store drains one cycle after its element; the epilogue multiplier sits between registers. The recorded frame beats are the unstalled schedule and are measured by the generated testbench; input gaps and output backpressure are counted separately and are never folded in
